findings.evidence: `γDown` is defined as a real scalar multiple of `γ μ` at CliffordAlgebraExtensions.lean:77-79; `Matrix.IsHermitian.smul {A} (h : A.IsHermitian) {k} (hk : IsSelfAdjoint k) : (k • A).IsHermitian` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hermitian.lean:252.
findings.fix: Prove `isHermitian_γ0_mul_γ (μ : Fin 4) : (γ0 * γ μ).IsHermitian` by the same case split, and derive `isHermitian_γ0_mul_γDown μ` from it via `Matrix.mul_smul` plus `Matrix.IsHermitian.smul` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hermitian.lean:252, `hk : IsSelfAdjoint k`, satisfied by `(r : ℂ)` for real `r`).
findings.issue: `isHermitian_γ0_mul_γDown` is stated only for the lowered gammas, but the lowering factor is irrelevant: `γDown μ = ((minkowskiMatrix … : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ μ` (line 77-79), a self-adjoint scalar. The general and standard fact is `(γ⁰ γ^μ)ᴴ = γ⁰ γ^μ`; as written, anyone needing the upper-index form (the roadmap states `T_q^{μν}` with upper indices, README §0.2 line 304) must redo the 64-case `fin_cases` brute force.

findings.issue: `total_mulVec_gaugeRotate_of_mem_unitaryGroup` re-unfolds `total_def` and reproves the statement from the parts instead of instantiating the general `total_mulVec_gaugeRotate` just above it — the special case duplicates the general proof. `QuarkPart.lean` does it the other way round (`quarkPart_mulVec_of_mem_unitaryGroup` is a one-line application of `quarkPart_mulVec`, line 232-235).

summary: The pointwise quark/total tensor API sits at a reasonable level (index types `n`, `m` free, `Fintype n`/`DecidableEq n` introduced only where the trace needs them, Hermiticity assumed exactly where used). Two level problems: the new gamma-matrix Hermiticity lemma is proved only for the lowered index when the fact is about `γ μ`, and the unitary-group corollary in `Total.lean` re-proves rather than instantiating the general lemma.
